text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, bivalirudin is not on FDA's drug shortage list. Corvale General holds 136 vials of 250 mg injection at 10.7 vials per day, providing 12.7 days on hand. Corvale East holds 270 vials at 8.8 vials per day, providing 30.8 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include bivalirudin as of 2026-10-21. A registered plant for a Dr. Reddy's-labeled product, Gland Pharma Limited (FEI 3002647489) in India, received a VAI classification on 2024-07-25.

Our position: Current inventory at Corvale General is below the preferred 14-day threshold. Corvale East supply is adequate. Multiple manufacturers not on FDA's shortage list are available for purchase.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Accord Healthcare, Inc. to replenish Corvale General stock; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer to evaluate Avenacy, LLC and Civica, Inc. as secondary sources; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. Buyer to monitor daily usage and inventory levels at both sites weekly; requires Pharmacy Manager approval.
4. Buyer to verify manufacturing site information for all purchased lots upon receipt; requires Quality Assurance approval.

Not recommended: No allocation or conservation measures at this time. No formulary changes or therapeutic substitutions.
